Suggest one park to visit in Madrid.

I suggest **Retiro Park (Parque del Buen Retiro)**. You can rent a rowboat on the lake, see the glass Crystal Palace, and stroll the shaded garden paths. It's also central and free to enter, so it's easy to fit into any itinerary.
